comparison.objective: Feed a pinned seam past a needle while removing each pin just in time, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-cloth feeding and timed pin extraction, not rigid collar adjustment or hex-key locking.
comparison.success_condition: Seam advances without a pin reaching the needle rather than repeatable safe carriage stopping and lock retention.
comparison.reason: It tests sequential deformable handling and hazard timing, not machine-axis damping.
